source: Section F: Suggested Learning Path of the supplied Generative AI PDF
pathway_note: The roadmap allows a practical beginner to use pretrained models and APIs before returning to deeper mathematics or specialist training content. Do not treat each advanced module as a prerequisite for a simple API-backed application.

stages.title: Understand the foundations
stages.focus: Generative AI concepts, machine-learning foundations, essential math/data, Python, and the development environment.
stages.milestone: Run or inspect a pretrained-model workflow and explain the input-to-output path.

stages.title: Learn how models work
stages.focus: Neural networks, NLP, tokenization, transformers, model architectures, training, and alignment.
stages.milestone: Explain next-token generation and distinguish training from inference.

stages.title: Build with prompts and APIs
stages.focus: Prompt/context design, backend API integration, structured outputs, and tool calling.
stages.milestone: Build a prototype with input validation, error handling, and structured output checks.

stages.title: Give applications external knowledge
stages.focus: Embeddings, vector retrieval, RAG, source citations, fine-tuning, and adaptation.
stages.milestone: Build and evaluate a question-answering prototype over an authorized document set.

stages.title: Work with agents and media
stages.focus: Agent architecture, tools, workflow orchestration, memory, image/audio/video, and multimodal systems.
stages.milestone: Build a bounded tool-using workflow or a measured multimodal application.

stages.title: Make systems trustworthy
stages.focus: Evaluation, security, privacy, data pipelines, knowledge management, and context engineering.
stages.milestone: Create a repeatable test suite, data-handling policy, and documented risk assessment.

stages.title: Prepare for production
stages.focus: Deployment, monitoring, scaling, cost, UX, responsible AI, governance, and legal review.
stages.milestone: Document an operational design with observability, safeguards, recovery, and responsible ownership.

stages.title: Specialize and complete the capstone
stages.focus: Select an optional specialization, troubleshoot failure modes, and deliver the enterprise capstone.
stages.milestone: Present a project with architecture documentation, actual test results, and acknowledged limitations.

optional_specializations.portfolio_goal: A deployed AI application with automated tests and documented evaluation results.
A knowledge assistant using authorized sources and measurable retrieval quality.
A bounded agent with measurable task success and controlled tool access.
A baseline-versus-adapted model comparison with measured outcomes.
A tested application that processes or generates more than one media type.
An evaluation suite and risk assessment for a defined AI application.

dependency_guidance: Learn basic Python before substantial model-training or backend-integration tasks.
Understand tokenization, embeddings, and context management before building RAG systems.
Learn model APIs and structured outputs before tool-using agents.
Understand evaluation and basic security before deploying systems that access private data or perform consequential actions.
Learn inference before studying quantization, model serving, and performance optimization.
Learn supervised learning and training fundamentals before fine-tuning.
Deep mathematics is revisited when useful; it is not a blanket gate on using pretrained models.
